# Applied Natural Language Processing Engineering

> Route, search and extract customer messages in four varieties of Arabic and English, and choose the model on measured quality, latency and cost. SDAIA Academy course AE-301, version 2027.1.0, in English.

Each slide is a heading such as "#### [day1#slide-id] Title": cite slides by that id, and each citation is a link (slides/day1.html#slide-id). These files are what a trainee sees: no speaker notes and no answer keys.

## Course

- [Course page](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-301/index.md): overview, outcomes, schedule and labs; the page itself is https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-301/index.html
- [The whole course](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-301/llms-full.txt): every unit, session and slide in one file, about 20,239 tokens
- [Practice questions](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-301/practice.html): questions to check yourself, with feedback after each answer

## Slides

- [Day 1: Represent](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-301/slides/day1.md): sessions: Tokenisation, Embeddings and semantic search, Inside the transformer, Decision models; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-301/slides/day1.html; about 6,231 tokens
- [Day 2: Generate](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-301/slides/day2.md): sessions: Generative language models, Prompting and structured outputs, Retrieval-augmented generation, Model selection and evaluation; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-301/slides/day2.html; about 6,083 tokens
- [Day 3: Adapt](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-301/slides/day3.md): sessions: Fine-tuning data, Fine-tuning an encoder, Low-rank and quantised adapters, Evaluate and deploy; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-301/slides/day3.html; about 5,955 tokens
- [Capstone: Capstone: a routing and extraction service and its defence](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-301/slides/day4.md): page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-301/slides/day4.html; about 1,391 tokens

## Labs

- [Lab 1.1: Three tokenisers, four varieties](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-301/labs/D1_1_tokenisers.ipynb): Day 1, Session 1, 25 min
- [Lab 1.2: Semantic search over 2,000 messages](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-301/labs/D1_2_semantic_search.ipynb): Day 1, Session 2, 25 min
- [Lab 1.3: Attention in an encoder and a decoder](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-301/labs/D1_3_attention.ipynb): Day 1, Session 3, 25 min
- [Lab 1.4: A routing baseline, without AI](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-301/labs/D1_4_baseline.ipynb): Day 1, Session 4, 25 min
- [Lab 2.1: Sampling, consistency and invented details](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-301/labs/D2_1_sampling.ipynb): Day 2, Session 1, 25 min
- [Lab 2.2: Masked, validated extraction](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-301/labs/D2_2_extraction.ipynb): Day 2, Session 2, 25 min
- [Lab 2.3: Grounded replies from the rule book](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-301/labs/D2_3_rag.ipynb): Day 2, Session 3, 25 min
- [Lab 2.4: Two open-weight models against the baseline](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-301/labs/D2_4_model_selection.ipynb): Day 2, Session 4, 25 min
- [Lab 3.1: A split without leakage](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-301/labs/D3_1_splits.ipynb): Day 3, Session 1, 25 min
- [Lab 3.2: Fine-tune the course encoder for routing](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-301/labs/D3_2_finetune_encoder.ipynb): Day 3, Session 2, 25 min
- [Lab 3.3: A low-rank adapter in a memory budget](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-301/labs/D3_3_lora.ipynb): Day 3, Session 3, 25 min
- [Lab 3.4: A small service with a model card](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-301/labs/D3_4_service.ipynb): Day 3, Session 4, 25 min
